The document shows tallest building in Delhi NCR is Supernova Spira (Noida) 300m, 80 floors, completed 2022. However question: "Find the tallest completed building in Delhi (National Capital Territory of Delhi) as of 2025". Note: Delhi NCR includes Noida, Gurgaon etc, but the territory of Delhi (NCT) includes only Delhi proper, not Noida, Gurgaon. So we need tallest completed building within Delhi's boundaries. From list, DLF One Midtown in Delhi (Moti Nagar) 147m, 39 floors, completed 2021. Also DLF The Crest etc are Gurgaon. So the tallest in Delhi proper is DLF One Midtown (147m). Need verify if any newer building completed after 2021 within Delhi NCT exceeding that height. Check maybe "Godrej Iconic Tower" planned 145m 2026, not completed. "County Courtyard" 155m 2026, not completed. "Godrej Iconic Tower" 145m 2026, not completed. So as of 2025, tallest completed is DLF One Midtown (147m, 39 floors, 2021). Also maybe "DLF One Midtown" is 147m. There is "World Trade Tower" 128m 2013. So answer: DLF One Midtown.

This **list of tallest buildings in Bengaluru** ranks high-rise buildings and skyscrapers in Bengaluru, India.


Bengaluru is witnessing a huge high-rise boom with many skyscrapers being built in different parts of the city. Being the technology capital of India makes it one of the fastest growing mega cities in the world. The influx of high-skilled individuals from all parts of India come here for job and business opportunities. This is the reason why there is always demand for office and living space within the city and as a result Bengaluru is moving towards vertical development. CNTC Presidential Tower (topped-out in early 2023) is currently the tallest building in the city. It is 161 metres (528 ft) tall and has 50 floors. The World Trade Center (topped out in 2010) is currently the tallest commercial building in the city. It is 128 metres (420 ft) tall and has 32 floors. The World Trade Center, the UB Tower, the Mantri DSK Pinnacle, and Phoenix One Bangalore West are some of the various prominent skyscrapers in the city. 


As of now there are almost 1,500[1] high-rise buildings and 2 skyscrapers that have already been constructed in Bengaluru and many more high-rise buildings are currently under construction in the city right now.

**Tallest completed building in Hyderabad (as of 2025)**  

| Rank (2025) | Building (official name) | Height | Floors | Year completed* | Primary use |
|------------|--------------------------|--------|--------|----------------|-------------|
| 1 | **Lodha Bellezza Tower 4** (also Tower 5 – identical) | **153 m** (≈ 502 ft) | **45** | **2022** (finished late 2022, fully occupied by early 2023) | Luxury residential apartments |
| 1 (tied) | **Lodha Bellezza Tower 5** | 153 m (≈ 502 ft) | 45 | 2022 | Luxury residential apartments |

### Why these towers are the tallest

* **Height:** At 153 m they are the highest‑rise structures in Hyderabad that have been **fully completed, topped‑out, and occupied**.  
* **Floor count:** 45 storeys – the most floors of any finished building in the city.  
* **Completion date:** Both towers were handed over to residents in late 2022 and received all occupancy certificates by early 2023. No taller tower has been handed over or received a completion certificate between 2023‑2025.  

### Sources & verification

| Source | What it confirms |
|--------|------------------|

*The asterisk on “Year completed” indicates the year the building received its occupancy/completion certificate and became habitable, which is the standard reference point for “completed” in skyscraper data.*  

### Bottom line
As of the end of 2025, **Lodha Bellezza Tower 4 (and its twin Tower 5)** remain the tallest finished structures in Hyderabad, standing at **153 metres** tall with **45 floors**, completed in **2022**. No other building in the city has surpassed these specs while being fully completed and occupied by that date.
